Synopsis:
Vin Diesel reprises his role as the antihero Riddick in the latest chapter of the groundbreaking saga. A dangerous, escaped convict wanted by every bounty hunter in the known galaxy, Riddick has been left for dead on a sun-scorched planet that appears to be lifeless. Soon, however, he finds himself fighting for survival against alien predators more lethal than any human he’s encountered. The only way off is for him to activate an emergency beacon and alert mercenaries who rapidly descend to the planet in search of their bounty. With time running out and a deadly storm on the horizon that no one could survive, his hunters won’t leave the planet without Riddick’s head as their trophy. Also starring Katee Sackhoff (TV’s Battlestar Galactica), Karl Urban (Star Trek Into Darkness) and Dave Bautista (WWE).

Produced By: Vin Diesel, Ted Field

recentItems.title: Easter Sunday | "I Got a Feeling" - Joe Confronts His Mom
recentItems.description:
Joe (Jo Koy) and his mother Susan (Lydia Gaston) finally hash it out over years of guilt trips, a secret trip to Los Angeles, and the truth about why she pushed him so hard growing up. It all boils down to one memory, learning to ride a bike with two broken wrists, and by the end the whole family is back at the table, singing karaoke like nothing happened.

Buy/Rent Easter Sunday! 
Universal Pictures Home Entertainment: https://preview.universalpicturesathome.com/movies/easter-sunday
Prime Video: https://www.amazon.com/s/ref=nb_sb_noss_1?url=search-alias%3Dinstant-video&field-keywords=Easter%20Sunday

Synopsis:
A man returns home for an Easter celebration with his riotous, bickering, eating, drinking, laughing and loving family, in this love letter to the Filipino-American community.
